svg.title: Software intake and its shared resource dependencies
svg.desc: One intake design uses virtual execution, local disk storage and guest networking provided by the shared platform. Those providers map to physical servers, drives and network equipment. The optional storage network is shown as context, not a dependency of local cache disks.
svg.text: Software intake | connected design and resource providers
Follow responsibilities into realization, then required resources and their physical backing.
Shared platform contracts are mapped context; physical counts, ports and placement remain site-owned.
